tasks.design: Mail in {EMAIL} names the guidance document in {DOCS}. A draft keeps a heading only when it names an instrument or a specimen step, the endoscopy technician checks that list, and only then reads those sections. The technician still talks with colleagues and still attends the event named on the {OTHER} society site.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidance headings are free text, so a stored title cannot show which section concerns an endoscope or a specimen.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded pass can drop a heading that lacks an instrument or specimen term, and the technician still checks every heading that remains.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a development should change how a scope is prepared or a specimen is handled, and what colleagues say at the event.
tasks.human_edge: The endoscopy technician judges whether a development changes sterile-field, instrument, or specimen work, and hears that from colleagues in person.

evidence.claim: A heading is kept only when it names an instrument or a specimen step. That filter does not decide whether preparation changes.
Health data are a special category. Care use rests on Article 9(2)(h) with professional secrecy.
Works council consent is required before records are used to measure staff.

assumptions: Published means sum to 100.1. Floors are screens 0, spreadsheets 0, mail 7, documents 42 and meetings 49. Two points go to screens (remainder 0.8) then mail (remainder 0.7). Spreadsheets stay at 0. The extra 0.1 in the published sum is not allocated.
No spreadsheet is used. Literature sits in {DOCS}. The event date and place sit on a professional society site, which is the {OTHER} category.
The actor on every step, including the heading draft, is the endoscopy technician, who scans those headings today. The machine appears only as the future fate of that draft.

The draft is ungated. The check verifies that each kept heading matches the literature and does not rewrite the list. The read uses only accepted heading list v1 and does not edit it. Nothing is sent outside and nothing is written to the dossier.
When the draft is empty, the technician reads the whole document. That case is the low end of the range.
Focal incremental upkeep is zero. The check sits inside the remaining-100 review. One system hour keeps the instrument and specimen term list.
Colleague talk and event participation stay at full remaining time. This design keeps no reading log of the technician.
